scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.test:packages: pnpm --filter @mosaic/contracts --if-present test && pnpm --filter @mosaic/design-tokens --if-present test && pnpm --filter @mosaic/design-tokens --if-present typecheck
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api/app apps/api/tests apps/api/scripts
scripts.typecheck:api: uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/app apps/api/migrations apps/api/scripts
scripts.migrate:api: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.relay:chat: uv run --project apps/api python apps/api/scripts/outbox_relay.py --watch --owner local-chat-relay --event-type chat.inference.execute
scripts.relay:generation: uv run --project apps/api python apps/api/scripts/outbox_relay.py --watch --owner local-generation-relay --event-type generation.accepted
scripts.worker:chat: uv run --project apps/api python apps/api/scripts/chat_consumer.py --worker-id local-chat-consumer
scripts.worker:generation: uv run --project apps/api python apps/api/scripts/generation_consumer.py --worker-id local-generation-consumer
scripts.worker:generation:video: uv run --project apps/api python apps/api/scripts/generation_consumer.py --queue video --worker-id local-video-generation-consumer
scripts.verify:web: pnpm lint:web && pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm check:web-boundaries && pnpm test:packages && pnpm test:web && pnpm build:web
scripts.verify:api: pnpm test:api && pnpm lint:api && pnpm typecheck:api && uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini heads
